rows.jp:
<sp(0)>しかし、同国との交渉の席<im(2)>に居合わせた

#c[E2E258]ドルチェノフ#cであるとの証言を行っている。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>However, Vice Foreign Minister Darlian,<im(2)>

rows.jp:

rows.en:
<sp(0)>Dorchenov assumed Supreme Leadership,

rows.notes: Report on Dorchenov's space mobile fortress.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>強硬派が支配するところとなった
#c[BE5050]ギガノス帝国#cに対しては、今後一層の

rows.en:
<sp(0)>With hardliners now ruling the
#c[BE5050]Giganos Empire#c, even greater vigilance
will be required going forward.

rows.en:
<sp(0)><im(1)>Regarding combat data on the #c[BE5050]Buster Ark#c<im(2)>

#c[5E8FD8]UCE Design Bureau#c has been submitted.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>報告によれば、#c[BE5050]バスターアーク#cの性能<im(3)>は
記録を追うごとに、当初確認された時よりも

rows.en:
<sp(0)>According to reports, the #c[BE5050]Buster Ark#c's<im(3)>
performance has improved with each record
compared to when first sighted.
rows.notes: Technical assessment of Buster Ark's continuous evolution.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>さらに同機には、何らかの自律制御システム

rows.en:
<sp(0)>Furthermore, an autonomous control system
is mounted, presumed to optimize control

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>つまり目標は、戦闘を重ねるごとに
より高いパフォーマンス<im(4)>を持つ機体へと
変化し続けているということになる。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>In other words, through repeated combat,
the target continually evolves into a unit<im(4)>
with ever greater performance.
rows.notes: Conclusion that Buster Ark evolves continuously.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>#c[BE5050]バスターアーク#cの消息は不明であるが、
以上の点を十分認識し、各部隊には
慎重な行動を願いたい。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>Though the #c[BE5050]Buster Ark#c's location is unknown,
all units are urged to act with caution and
full awareness of these points.

report.translator_summary: Completed translation of op09_04 (12 rows), concluding Operation 09 with two intelligence reports. The first, from UCE Intelligence, documents the political fallout of the coup in Giganos, highlighting Relena Darlian's testimony exposing Dorchenov as Marshal Guiltorre's real assassin despite official propaganda blaming Meio Plato. The second, authored by Preventer Lady Une, analyzes combat data from the UCE Design Bureau revealing that the Buster Ark possesses an autonomous learning system that optimizes and enhances its performance with each battle.
